title: Thank You, SelectUSA
body:
Thank you SelectUSA, thank you to the judges of Open Tech 1 Session and the Finals, and thank you to everyone who has believed in us, in our products, in our technology and has supported us all along!

VanaM Team is only getting started!
body_ko:
SelectUSA에 감사드리고, 오픈테크 1 세션과 결승의 심사위원 여러분께 감사드리며, 저희와 저희 제품, 그리고 기술을 믿고 지금까지 응원해주신 모든 분들께 감사드립니다!

VanaM 팀은 이제 시작입니다!
